name: cerdasnet-vps-control
description: Production-ready multi-token UpCloud VPS control panel

scripts.setup: npm ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
